name: Glorious GMMK Pro
notes: 64-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Glorious GMMK Pro, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/hrvach/deskhop/issues/61#issuecomment-2048227268. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
